description: Drainage Gully Cleaning Programme DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Schedule and Monitor of Gully Cleaning for Dublin City These datasets show the gully cleaning statistics from 2004 to September 14th 2011. It consists attached 6 No. Excel Spreadsheets with the datasets from the Daily Returns section of the Gully Cleaning Application and one dataset from the Gully Repairs section of the gully application. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Built Environment, Transport and Infrastructure, blocked-drains-sewers, drainage, rainwater-gullies. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
